subject: Brightleaf Health POC kickoff — scope, metrics & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightleafhealth.com>, Carlos Ramirez <c.ramirez@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T14:03:00Z
Subject: Brightleaf Health POC kickoff — scope, metrics & next steps

Thanks again for the call today, Samantha/Carlos — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed plan so we’re all aligned before kickoff: 

Pain points you shared
- High inference cost at peak traffic and unpredictable token spend
- p95 latency spikes during batch processing (affects UX)
- Tight security/PHI constraints + need for VPC/private deployment options

POC goals (success criteria)
- Reduce per-request cost by ~30% (baseline vs POC optimized config)
- p95 latency under 250ms for the common prompt set
- Validate integration via VPC peering and logging/audit visibility

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (prep): access, SSO/keys, sample prompt set and evals defined
- Week 1: baseline performance on current infra (tokens, latency, cost)
- Week 2: apply Redwood optimizations (batching, prefix caching, quantization profile)
- Week 3: iterate on prompts/rollout policies and model variants
- Week 4: finalize evals, handoff playbook + cost/latency report

Metrics we’ll track
- p95 latency (ms), p50 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), cost per 1M tokens
- Quality metrics: BLEU/ROUGE-ish where applicable + manual eval spot checks

Owners
- Brightleaf: Samantha Lee (PM), Carlos Ramirez (Eng)
- Redwood: Marissa (Account Lead), Rishi (AE) — procurement/contract coordination, Neha (SE) — tech lead for setup & evals

Access/setup checklist (what we need from Brightleaf before kickoff)
1) AWS account number(s) for VPC peering + IAM contact OR test credentials for a staging environment
2) SSO metadata for Okta/AD (if you want SSO)
3) Sample prompt set (CSV or JSON) + 200–500 representative requests for baseline
4) Any data redaction requirements and SOC2/Risk contacts

Attachments: Brightleaf_POC_MA_Plan.pdf (scope & SOW draft) attached. I’m also attaching detailed access steps separately (redwood-poc-access-instructions.txt) — Neha will follow up with the tech checklist.

Next steps
- Can you confirm kickoff date on Aug 22 and assign an infra contact?
- Provide AWS account ID + sample prompt set by EOD Aug 19 if possible
- I’ll loop in procurement (Rishi) to kick off the MSA/PO paperwork; Rishi — I’ll flag any timeline constraints.

Thanks — excited to get started.
—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Brightleaf Health POC kickoff — scope, metrics & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear plan. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- We’re good to target Aug 22 for kickoff. Carlos will be the infra lead for access.
- Success criteria: aiming for >=30% cost reduction vs our current baseline and p95 <250ms on the provided prompt set. If we hit both we’ll consider the POC a success.
- We do require SOC 2 Type II evidence and an overview of data handling for PHI — can you share the latest SOC 2 report and data flow diagram?

Action items from Brightleaf
- I’ll send sample prompt files + a small anonymized dataset by Aug 18.
- Looping in procurement as requested. Procurement will need the SOW and MSA draft (please send to procurement@brightleafhealth.com).

Thanks — looking forward to next week.
—

Hi Carlos / Samantha — attaching the access checklist (redwood-poc-access-instructions.txt). Key items we need to proceed: 
- AWS account number(s) + preferred VPC CIDR range for peering
- IAM admin contact and a short-lived test user with the following roles: EC2Describe, VPCModify (peering), S3Read (for test data), CloudWatchRead
- SSO metadata (Okta/AD) if you want SSO — otherwise we can provision API keys for the POC
- Sample prompt set: please include 200–500 representative prompts and expected/acceptable outputs for 30–50 control cases so we can run automated evals

Technical notes on privacy/compliance: Redwood supports private deployments and can restrict logs to your VPC. We’ll provide a data flow diagram and SOC 2 Type II cert to procurement (Marissa/Rishi will attach to the SOW).

Attaching: redwood-poc-access-instructions.txt (contains step-by-step peering and test flow).

I’ll stand by on Aug 22 for the kickoff; once we have access we’ll run the environment validation (connectivity + small baseline run).
